title: Whistle, horn and bell catalogs
prerequisites: Supply your own licensed audio files; none are shipped. This recipe uses working package-relative paths; the public URI-only schema rejects them.
notes: FUSE schema requires URI-shaped strings, but installed FUSE SHA256 9A30D165... resolves file://Audio incorrectly. Relative Audio/... and file(Audio/...) resolve correctly; tested 2026-09-21 without loading audio.
RF uses three catalog ARRAY files declared under manifest mixintos.whistles/horns/bells; these are not graph roots.
RF horn keys rename t to time; FUSE whistle pitch/lerp fields lack RF catalog equivalents.
Use package-relative Audio/cvw-*.wav paths in RF catalogs. Horns allow one or two layers; ordered keyframe times/values are fractions; bell index times are positive and increasing.
